relations.name: facility_registry
relations.meaning: A permitted facility identified by NPDES permit number and evidenced name.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple cites source_manifest.json facility entry and/or distinct EXTERNAL_PERMIT_NMBR rows in structured CSV extracts.
relations.construction_rule: Emit one tuple per selected facility permit number; referent id stable from permit number.

relations.name: discharge_point_registry
relations.meaning: A permit discharge feature (outfall or monitoring location) tied to a facility permit.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground to permit_limits.csv and/or dmr_measurements.csv PERM_FEATURE_ID / PERM_FEATURE_NMBR rows.
relations.construction_rule: One referent per distinct (permit_number, perm_feature_id) pair; join facility via permit number.

relations.name: parameter_registry
relations.meaning: A monitored parameter identified by EPA parameter code and description.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground to PARAMETER_CODE and PARAMETER_DESC fields in structured CSV extracts.
relations.construction_rule: One referent per distinct parameter_code across sources.

relations.name: monitoring_period_registry
relations.meaning: A DMR monitoring period end date for a facility as recorded in discharge monitoring evidence.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground to MONITORING_PERIOD_END_DATE values in dmr_measurements.csv.
relations.construction_rule: One referent per distinct (permit_number, period_end_date) appearing in DMR evidence.

relations.name: limit_set_record
relations.meaning: A permit limit-set bundle naming a monitoring schedule and any verbatim conditional comment from the limit record.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground to LIMIT_SET_ID, LIMIT_SET_DESIGNATOR, LIMIT_SET_NAME, LIMIT_SET_SCHEDULE_ID, LIMIT_SET_STATUS_FLAG, and DMR_COMMENT_TEXT in permit_limits.csv.
relations.construction_rule: One referent per distinct limit_set_id; attach facility and discharge_point via shared permit/feature keys.

relations.name: permit_limit_assertion
relations.meaning: A permit-recorded numeric limit value with units, statistical basis, enforceability flags, and effective dates.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground each tuple to the corresponding row in permit_limits.csv keyed by LIMIT_VALUE_ID.
relations.construction_rule: One tuple per permit_limits.csv row; referent id from limit_value_id; parse dates and numeric fields literally.

relations.name: dmr_measurement_assertion
relations.meaning: A reported DMR measurement row including value, units, qualifiers, and NODI code as recorded.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground to dmr_measurements.csv row keyed by DMR_EVENT_ID and DMR_FORM_VALUE_ID / DMR_VALUE_ID.
relations.construction_rule: One referent per DMR measurement row; link structural keys to compiled registries; leave reported_value_nmbr null when absent.

relations.name: limit_period_overlaps_monitoring_period
relations.meaning: Mechanical calendar overlap between a limit effective period and a monitoring period end date.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation inputs permit_limit_assertion and monitoring_period_registry; overlap computed deterministically from parsed dates.
relations.construction_rule: SQL derivation: monitoring period end date falls within [limit_begin_date, limit_end_date] inclusive.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Cartesian join on shared facility only where date predicate holds.

relations.name: measurement_limit_structural_candidate
relations.meaning: Mechanically supportable correspondence between a DMR measurement and a candidate permit limit sharing permit, outfall, parameter, limit linkage, and temporal overlap.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation over dmr_measurement_assertion, permit_limit_assertion, and limit_period_overlaps_monitoring_period.
relations.construction_rule: Join on facility, discharge_point, parameter; prefer explicit LIMIT_VALUE_ID linkage when present; require temporal overlap.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Emit all tuples satisfying structural join keys without selecting a single applicable limit.

relations.name: fy2025_in_scope_measurement
relations.meaning: DMR measurements whose monitoring period end date falls in Federal FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30 inclusive).
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation over monitoring_period_registry joined to dmr_measurement_assertion with explicit FY2025 date window.
relations.construction_rule: Filter monitoring_period.period_end_date within intention contract temporal bounds.

relations.name: fy2025_monitoring_requirement
relations.meaning: Limit-set monitoring requirements with permit limit effective dates intersecting Federal FY2025.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation over limit_set_record and permit_limit_assertion effective dates.
relations.construction_rule: Include limit sets having at least one permit_limit_assertion overlapping FY2025.

relations.name: measurement_has_numeric_result
relations.meaning: Measurements with an ordinary numeric reported value suitable as input to numeric comparison mechanics.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation over dmr_measurement_assertion: reported_value_nmbr is non-null and no blocking NODI-only absence pattern.
relations.construction_rule: Mechanical predicate on DMR_VALUE_NMBR presence; does not assert compliance or violation.

relations.name: monitoring_expectation_without_numeric_result
relations.meaning: FY2025 monitoring slots or DMR rows lacking an ordinary numeric reported result but evidenced by schedule structure or non-numeric DMR reporting.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation combining fy2025_in_scope_measurement anti-join measurement_has_numeric_result plus schedule-implied slots where evidenced.
relations.construction_rule: Universe for Purpose C: in-scope FY2025 expectations with absent/non-numeric ordinary results.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Pair each qualifying measurement or schedule slot with a stable monitoring_expectation referent.

relations.name: evidenced_operational_context
relations.meaning: Positive operational or discharge-occurrence facts evidenced in DMR NODI codes, permit text, or operational records for a bounded period.
relations.grounding_contract: Each accepted tuple must cite permit PDF excerpts, DMR rows, or structured operational evidence used to establish the fact.
relations.construction_rule: Extract and classify only positively evidenced operational states (e.g., documented no discharge, discharge occurred, special study active); do not infer from missing reports.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Generate candidates from limit_set conditional_comment text, NODI-coded DMR rows, and permit-package PDF passages tied to FY2025 periods.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether available evidence establishes a specific operational context (discharge occurrence, no-discharge, event activation) for a requirement period.

relations.name: limit_applicability_judgment
relations.meaning: Purpose A judgment selecting the enforceable numeric limit applicable to a reported measurement context or recording why applicability cannot be established.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground to measurement_limit_structural_candidate tuples plus permit/limit evidence; unresolved tuples cite evidential gaps.
relations.construction_rule: Evaluate each fy2025_in_scope_measurement against structural candidates; select at most one applicable enforceable numeric limit or route to unresolved.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate set per in-scope measurement drawn from measurement_limit_structural_candidate.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Which candidate limit is the applicable enforceable numeric limit for the measurement context.

relations.name: numeric_comparison_regime_judgment
relations.meaning: Purpose A classification of whether a measurement/limit pair is subject to enforceable numeric compliance comparison, report-only monitoring, or non-comparable reporting.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground to permit_limit_assertion enforceability fields, optional_monitoring_flag, and dmr_measurement_assertion value shape.
relations.construction_rule: Apply Purpose A policy on enforceable numeric limits versus report-only or qualitatively reported results.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per fy2025_in_scope_measurement after limit applicability is considered.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether monitoring is enforceable for numeric compliance comparison versus report-only or not comparable.

relations.name: exceedance_judgment
relations.meaning: Purpose A determination whether a reported measurement exceeds an established applicable enforceable numeric limit.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground to accepted limit_applicability_judgment, numeric_comparison_regime_judgment, and source measurement/limit values.
relations.construction_rule: Compare only when enforceable numeric comparison is established and units/statistical bases align; otherwise omit exceedance outcome.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Generate for measurements with ACCEPT limit applicability and enforceable_numeric_comparison regime.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the reported measurement exceeds the applicable limit when comparison prerequisites are met.

relations.name: monitoring_requirement_applicability_judgment
relations.meaning: Purpose B judgment whether a monitoring requirement was required, not required, or conditionally resolved for Federal FY2025.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground to limit_set_record, permit_limit_assertion schedules, evidenced_operational_context, and permit PDF excerpts.
relations.construction_rule: Three-valued outcome: required, not_required, or unresolved; evaluate conditional triggers from evidence before assigning required/not_required.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per fy2025_monitoring_requirement crossed with FY2025 applicability periods.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether evidence establishes that monitoring was required, not required, or cannot be determined for FY2025.

relations.name: missing_evidence_semantic_judgment
relations.meaning: Purpose C classification of what evidence establishes for a no-result or non-numeric monitoring episode in FY2025.
relations.grounding_contract: Ground to monitoring_expectation_without_numeric_result, dmr_measurement_assertion NODI codes, evidenced_operational_context, and permit conditions.
relations.construction_rule: Assign exactly one primary taxonomy state when positive evidence supports it; never infer compliance or violation from absence alone.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Which Purpose C semantic state best describes the missing-evidence episode.

limitations: 00_intention_contract.json does not declare an explicit consumer_fields block; semantic_identity bindings are derived from row_expectations and universe_scope granularity for purposes A, B, and C.

Permit PDF prose beyond structured CSV fields is not fully enumerated in sources/; evidenced_operational_context and conditional requirement evaluation may be incomplete until permit extraction passes run.
Closed-world negatives (e.g., established absence of a limit) are not modeled as World relations per kernel constraints.
